record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: For 1 <= r <= 2, let P_{r,2} denote the ideal of (r,2)-summing operators. Determine whether the trace φ_{r,\infty}(·|P_{r,2}) on (P_{r,2})^{APP}_{r,\infty} constructed in Theorem 2.4 is spectral.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $1\le r\le 2$. An operator $T:X\to Y$ between Banach spaces is called $(r,2)$-summing if there exists a constant $C>0$ such that for every finite family $x_1,\dots,x_n\in X$,
$$\Big(\sum_{k=1}^n\|Tx_k\|^r\Big)^{1/r}\le C\,\sup_{\|x^*\|\le 1}\Big(\sum_{k=1}^n |x^*(x_k)|^2\Big)^{1/2}.$$
The class of all such operators forms a Banach operator ideal $\mathfrak P_{r,2}$, equipped with its natural norm $\pi_{r,2}$.

For an operator $T:X\to X$ on a Banach space $X$, let $a_n(T)$ denote its $n$-th approximation number,
$$a_n(T)=\inf\{\|T-A\|:A:X\to X,\ \mathrm{rank}(A)<n\}.$$
For $0<p<\infty$ and $0<q\le\infty$, the approximation component of $\mathfrak P_{r,2}$ of type $(p,q)$ is
$$(\mathfrak P_{r,2})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{p,q}=\{T\in\mathfrak P_{r,2}:(a_n(T))_{n\ge 1}\in\ell_{p,q}\},$$
where $\ell_{p,q}$ is the Lorentz sequence space. In particular,
$$(\mathfrak P_{r,2})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}=\{T\in\mathfrak P_{r,2}:\sup_{n\ge 1} n^{1/r}a_n(T)<\infty\}.$$

Assume that on the component $(\mathfrak P_{r,2})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$ (acting on Banach spaces) there exists a continuous linear trace $\varphi_{r,\infty}(\,\cdot\,|\mathfrak P_{r,2})$ (a linear functional satisfying $\varphi(ST)=\varphi(TS)$ whenever both compositions lie in the component, and reducing to the usual finite-rank trace on finite-rank operators).

Recall that a trace $\tau$ defined on an operator ideal component is called spectral if for every operator $T$ in its domain,
$$\tau(T)=\sum_{n=1}^\infty \lambda_n(T),$$
where $(\lambda_n(T))_{n\ge 1}$ denotes the eigenvalue sequence of $T$ (counted with algebraic multiplicities and arranged in non-increasing order of absolute values).

Question: Is the trace $\varphi_{r,\infty}(\,\cdot\,|\mathfrak P_{r,2})$ on $(\mathfrak P_{r,2})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$ spectral?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an explicit open problem on traces on operator ideals over the class of all Banach spaces. Web searches did not turn up a published resolution; available literature on summing operators, eigenvalue estimates and singular traces discusses related Lidskii-type results but no specific answer concerning the spectrality of the trace $\varphi_{r,\infty}(\cdot|\mathfrak P_{r,2})$ on the approximation component $(\mathfrak P_{r,2})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$ for $1\le r\le 2$.

status_evidence.title: Traces on Operator Ideals (zbMATH listing)
status_evidence.snippet: Lists problems on traces on operator ideals over Banach spaces, including spectrality questions for traces on approximation components.
status_evidence.claim: The spectrality of this specific trace is listed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Special issue in Memory of Albrecht Pietsch
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys Pietsch's work on operator ideals, eigenvalue distributions and singular/spectral traces.
status_evidence.claim: No published resolution of the (r,2)-summing spectrality problem appears in the surveyed literature.
